stat.apotheosis.simulatedspawner:simulat: The spawner no longer spawns mobs; instead it pushes simulated player-kill loot into the container above. It stops when there is no container above or the container is full. Mutually exclusive with Simulated Fishing: enabling it removes the fishing upgrade and refunds the fishing rod.
stat.apotheosis.simulatedspawner:fishing: The spawner no longer spawns mobs; instead it simulates fishing at the spawner's pace and pushes the catch into the container above. It stops when there is no container above or the container is full. Mutually exclusive with Simulated Drops: enabling it removes the kill-simulation upgrade and refunds the diamond sword.
stat.apotheosis.simulatedspawner:bonus_l: Looting / Luck of the Sea (Diamond Block)
Each level adds +1 Looting to simulated kills and +1 Luck of the Sea to simulated fishing. Max stack size is configurable (default 10).
Simulated kills drop all condition-gated items (including modded ones, e.g. Farmer's Delight knife kills); simulated fishing additionally produces one of every item in the treasure pool (including modded additions).
stat.apotheosis.simulatedspawner:revelat: Simulated kills temporarily wear the Ring of the Seven Curses, granting Enigmatic Legacy's unique per-mob ring drops (extra arrows from skeletons, slime balls from zombies, totem from evokers, etc.).
enchantment.simulatedspawner.unbreakable: Applying it adds the Unbreakable tag to the item (it never loses durability) and the enchantment is then removed automatically. The enchanted book is crafted from 1 book + 8 obsidian (shapeless).
message.simulatedspawner.upgrade_replace: Simulation upgrades are mutually exclusive: removed "%s" and refunded %s
tooltip.simulatedspawner.enchant_locked: Enchantments locked (the enchanting table only upgrades existing enchantments, up to level %s)
message.simulatedspawner.anvil_lock_warn: Locked enchantments can never be unlocked
message.simulatedspawner.spawn_egg_black: That mob is on the spawner blacklist; the spawn egg was returned
tooltip.simulatedspawner.affix_disabled: %s affix(es) disabled (re-enable them at the Augmenting Table)
